summary: EShallgo Inc filed a Form 6-K reporting a securities purchase agreement dated June 30, 2026, for a registered direct offering. The company issued 200,000 Class A ordinary shares at $1.00 per share and pre-funded warrants for 550,000 shares at $0.99 per warrant, raising ~$750,000 gross proceeds. The warrants were exercised immediately at $0.01 per share. Univest Securities acted as placement agent, receiving 7% cash fee plus up to $50,000 expense reimbursement. Proceeds are for working capital. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; the filing is a standard disclosure of a shelf takedown under an effective F-3 registration statement.
